reason: A $99 lifetime deal is my kind of offer, and I'd like the iPhone and Android captures, but this is a brand new tool with zero reviews. I've watched plenty of lifetime-deal tools die or stall within a year. I'd sign up for the free tier, see that it's desktop only, and then wait for reviews or a cheaper launch deal.
objection: No track record. A lifetime deal is only worth it if the company sticks around, and the change alerts will probably spam me with false positives from carousels, cookie banners and dynamic content.
would_change_my_mind: A launch lifetime deal around $59, or a free trial that includes mobile devices so I can check myself whether the screenshots and change alerts are any good before paying.
